subject: One-Day Licenses and New Year's Eve Extensions
overview: The Commission approved several one-day licenses for community events and clarified the legal requirements for establishments seeking to extend their operating hours on New Year's Eve. Members also reviewed compliance for seasonal outdoor dining and building code restrictions related to entertainment licenses.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Medford Brewing Company to operate a beer garden at Wrights Pond for the Pumpkin Float on October 26.

items.title: Arts Collaborative One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved three one-day liquor licenses for opening and closing receptions at the Arts Collaborative on November 7, 16, and 17.

items.title: Alta Cuba Sidewalk Dining
items.summary: Determined that sidewalk dining at Alta Cuba is permissible provided it meets all city codes and passes necessary department inspections.

items.title: New Year's Eve Operating Hours
items.summary: Deferred formal guidance on extending New Year's Eve hours to 1:00 AM pending a legal opinion from KP Law regarding city ordinances and building code restrictions for venues without entertainment licenses.
